Name: DotCells
Label: Dots across map
Description: Controls the number of dot cells across the normalized map.

Name: DotRadius
Label: Dot radius
Description: Controls the radius of each solid circular dot relative to its cell.

Name: DotSoftness
Label: Dot softness
Description: Controls how gently each dot fades into the surrounding space.

Name: DotRotation
Label: Rotation
Description: Rotates the dot lattice around its center in degrees.

Name: DotInvert
Label: Invert
Description: Swaps the dots and the space between them.
